title: Tera Pilot evaluation result — schema v1
description: Machine-readable contract for one evaluation run. Mirrored by eval/schema.py (manual validator used by the runner and tests). status describes the run; metrics.test_passed describes the test execution; metrics.verification_status describes the verification step; workspace.baseline describes the pristine repo state. They are never conflated.

commit.description: Base commit the task started from, when the fixture is a git repo.

repo_hash.description: SHA-256 fingerprint of the fixture repo contents.

baseline.description: Result of running test_command on the pristine repo, before any agent work. Recorded for the fake driver always; for the api driver with --baseline.

test_output.description: Potentially sensitive — redacted from reports by default.

tokens_in.description: Optional: input tokens from the provider usage tracker.

tokens_out.description: Optional: output tokens from the provider usage tracker.

request_count.description: Optional: number of provider requests this run made.

cancelled.description: Optional: true when the run was cancelled (e.g. user Stop).

provider_errors.description: Optional (P1.8): number of provider-level errors observed during the run (terminal SSE error events / error steps).

tool_errors.description: Optional (P1.8): number of agent/tool error steps observed during the run.

evidence.description: Optional (P1.8): real per-run evidence — the actual diff the agent produced, error counters, and the self_verify result. No hidden telemetry; every field is present only when it was actually observed.

diff.description: The actual workspace diff produced by the agent (git diff for git fixtures, else a file-content comparison against the pristine fixture).

self_verify.description: The result of the agent's self_verify call (truncated), or null when self_verify was not called.

final_output.description: Potentially sensitive — the agent's final answer.
